source: *yawn* Good morning. You’re all up earlier than usual.
translation: *打哈欠* 早上好。你们今天都比平时起得早。

source: G’morning, Gramps!
translation: 早上好，Gramps！

source: I figured you’d be up soon, so I went ahead and made you some coffee!
translation: 我想着你很快就会起来，所以先给你煮了些咖啡！

source: Ah, thanks Aiden.
translation: 啊，谢谢你，Aiden。

source: Come chill with us for a bit, sir.
translation: 来和我们一起放松一会儿吧，先生。

source: What are you guys up to?
translation: 你们在做什么？

source: Ooh, Lloyd is doing some of his magic mumbo-jumbo again! This time he’s reading our palms!
translation: 哦，Lloyd又在搞他的魔法玄学了！这次他在给我们看手相！

source: Hmm, you have quite a lot of interesting hobbies, Lloyd.
translation: 嗯，你有不少有趣的爱好啊，Lloyd。

source: Why, thank you, sir~ But I’ll admit I only know the basics of palm-reading.
translation: 哎呀，谢谢您，先生～不过我得承认，我只懂些手相的基础。

source: Hehe, first it was the stars-thingy, then the spooky cards, and now this…
translation: 嘿嘿，先是星星那玩意儿，然后是吓人的卡牌，现在又是这个……

source: Heeey… You gotta admit they’re nice ice-breakers!
translation: 嘿……你得承认，它们是很不错的破冰话题！

source: You’ve piqued my interest either way… how does it work…?
translation: 不管怎样，你勾起我的兴趣了……它是怎么起作用的……？

source: Well, you just look at someone’s hand like this and analyze specific creases!
translation: 嗯，你只要像这样看看一个人的手，再分析特定的掌纹就行了！

source: What does mine say?
translation: 那我的怎么说？

source: Hmm… you seem to have a broken heart line...
translation: 嗯……你的感情线似乎断了……

source: Broken heart?! Wow, Lloyd you didn’t have to call out Gramps’ marriage like that.
translation: 心碎？！哇，Lloyd，你没必要这样揭Gramps婚姻的伤疤吧。

source: N-No! A heart line is located above the head line, and is the highest horizontal one on the palm!
translation: 不、不是！感情线位于智慧线的上方，是手掌上最高的那条横线！

source: Hnghh… So many lines…
translation: 唔……这么多线……

source: Sir Goro’s heart line is only broken for the first third, though! The rest is continuously long and even has a fork at the end!
translation: 不过Goro先生的感情线只在前段三分之一处断开！其余部分又长又连贯，末端甚至还有分叉！

source: And that means…?
translation: 那意味着……？

source: It reflects upheavals at the early stages of your romantic life, but in the latter part it shows a promising partnership that will last for a lifetime!
translation: 这反映出你的感情生活早期会有动荡，但后半段则预示着一段能持续一生、很有希望的伴侣关系！

source: The fork, however, indicates the willingness to sacrifice everything for love!
translation: 而那个分叉，则表明愿意为爱付出一切！

source: Whoa… Why is Gramps’ fortune all about romance?
translation: 哇……为什么Gramps的运势全都是感情方面的？

source: Yeah… It seems so out of character…
translation: 是啊……这太不像他了……

source: Lloyd is just doing it for fun. Don’t take it seriously.
translation: Lloyd只是图个乐。别当真。

source: Heyyy! There are plenty of studies that talk about these mystic energies! It could be real!
translation: 嘿！有很多研究都在谈这些神秘能量！说不定是真的！

source: Like I said, I’m just using it as an ice-breaker!
translation: 就像我说的，我只是拿它来破冰而已！

source: Speaking of breaking ice, did Yoshinori already go to the site to work? I don’t see him.
translation: 说到破冰，Yoshinori已经去工地工作了吗？我没看到他。

source: Oh, he left not long before you got up. I’m not sure what for though…
translation: 哦，在你起床前不久他就出去了。不过我不确定他是去做什么……

source: Actually, that reminds me – since when have you had a normal person schedule, Jin?!
translation: 对了，这倒提醒我了——Jin，你从什么时候起有正常人的作息了？！

source: A-Ahh... Yeah… It’s still been kind of difficult, but ever since I started taking Sir Goro’s advice and drinking my morning coffee, it’s helped a lot.
translation: 啊、啊……是啊……虽然还是有些困难，但自从我听从Goro先生的建议开始喝晨间咖啡后，帮助很大。

source: I can’t work well without it, so I thought it’d give you a boost too.
translation: 没有它我就没法好好工作，所以我想它也能让你振作一些。

source: Yeah. I figured we could really use the extra hands to get things done, so I called Yoichi and Taiga yesterday.
translation: 是啊。我觉得我们确实需要更多人手来把事情办完，所以昨天我叫来了Yoichi和Taiga。

source: Our intent was to let Emilia recover, then inform you.
translation: 我们的打算是先让Emilia恢复，再通知你。

source: I understand your decision to remove Emilia as our inspector.
translation: 我理解你们决定撤下Emilia的检查员职务。

source: A-Ah…! Yes...!
Come ooon!!! We rarely have this many people around during the winter season! And besides, the holidays are just around the corner!
translation: 拜托嘛！！！冬天可很少有这么多人在这里！而且节日马上就到了！

source: And the nose isn’t the only tip that’s red on this reindeer~
translation: 而这只驯鹿可不只有鼻尖是红的哦～

source: KYAAAAA! I knew it’d look perfect on you, Aiden!
translation: 呀啊啊啊！我就知道这身穿在你身上会完美无缺，Aiden！

source: Ahh~ The things I do to tickle you guys’ pickle.
translation: 啊～为了逗你们开心，我可真是什么都做。

source: Damn… you even oiled yourself up, Aiden…
translation: 天啊……你甚至还给自己抹了油，Aiden……

source: Props to your commitment.
translation: 佩服你的敬业精神。

source: Well, the original suit Yuri gave me had more pieces, but I figured this was more my style.
translation: 嗯，Yuri给我的原版服装其实还有更多部件，不过我觉得这样更符合我的风格。

source: It’s perfect, it’s perfect! Aiden you’re the beeeest!
translation: 太完美了，太完美了！Aiden你最棒了！

source: Hngh… I’m starting to feel giddy…
translation: 唔……我开始觉得晕乎乎的了……

source: What’s that, Jin? You wanna ride?
translation: 怎么了，Jin？你想骑上来吗？

source: W-Wait… Is it okay for you to wear something like this…? I mean, maybe if it’s just us, but Mr. Clermont is here too, right…?
translation: 等、等等……你穿成这样真的没问题吗……？我是说，如果只有我们也许还好，但Clermont先生也在这里吧……？

source: Why yes, I am!
translation: 没错，我就在这里！

source: And I’ve never felt so alive! It’s been years since I’ve had this much fun!
translation: 而且我从没觉得这么充满活力！我已经很多年没有这么开心过了！

source: I don’t know how you even find the time, Yuri…
translation: 我真不知道你究竟从哪儿找来这么多时间，Yuri……

source: W-Well, I haven’t seen Goro yet either!
translation: 嗯、嗯，我也还没见到Goro！

source: Oh, he said he went off to grab some booze for us! I think he’s pulling something special out of his office.
translation: 哦，他说要去给我们拿些酒！我想他正从办公室里拿出什么特别的东西。

source: Anyway, quit stalling! Go get in your costume and fetch Dad!
translation: 总之，别磨蹭了！去换上你的服装，把爸爸叫来！

source: {i}Not wanting to aggravate Yuri, I went into the bathroom and put my costume on before heading to the office to find Sir Goro…{/i}
translation: {i}不想惹Yuri生气，我走进浴室穿好服装，然后前往办公室找Goro先生……{/i}

source: Goro? Are you in here?
translation: Goro？你在里面吗？

source: Ah, Yoshinori. Yes, I’m here.
translation: 啊，Yoshinori。是的，我在。

source: W-Whoa! What are you wearing?!
translation: 哇、哇！你穿的是什么？！

source: *sigh* I'm not sure either, but Yuri was insistent that I wear it.
translation: *叹气* 我也不太确定，不过Yuri坚持要我穿上它。

source: She says that she regretted how 'covered' I was during the last costume party and wanted to give me more eye-candy this time.
translation: 她说她后悔上次化装派对时我裹得太严实，这次想给我多添些养眼的打扮。

source: Ahehe, I'd say she definitely succeeded...
translation: 啊哈哈，我得说她绝对成功了……

source: Are you sure it’s alright to go out there with just that on…? I mean… Won’t you get cold?
translation: 你确定只穿成这样出去没问题吗……？我是说……不会冷吗？

source: I actually tried to close the jacket, but there's no buttons. I think she did that on purpose.
translation: 我其实试过把夹克扣上，但它没有纽扣。我想她是故意的。

source: I'm not sure it would close even with that... It looks tight on your arms already.
translation: 就算有纽扣，我也不确定它能不能扣上……它在你手臂上看起来已经很紧了。

source: Heh, I’m surprised you noticed my arms from where you’ve been staring.
translation: 呵，我很意外你一直盯着的地方居然还注意到了我的手臂。

source: Gah… I can’t help it, I couldn’t keep my eyes off your…
translation: 啊……我没办法，我的眼睛根本没法从你的……移开。

source: Gah… I can’t help it, I couldn’t keep my eyes off your…{fast}
translation: 啊……我没办法，我的眼睛根本没法从你的……移开。{fast}

source: Wrapped package
translation: 包装好的礼物

source: Th-That package is wrapped really nicely…
translation: 那、那个礼物包装得真漂亮……

source: Really? Why don’t you come open it then~?
translation: 是吗？那你为什么不过来拆开它呢～？

source: Candy Cane
translation: 糖果拐杖

source: I’d like a taste of that candy cane…
translation: 我想尝一尝那根糖果拐杖……

source: You can take a lick if you’d like~
translation: 想的话，你可以舔一口哦～

source: Jingle Balls
translation: 叮当作响的球

source: D-Do those balls jingle?
translation: 那、那对球会叮当响吗？

source: Depends on how you play with them.
translation: 取决于你怎么玩它们。

source: Why don’t you give it a try?
translation: 你为什么不试试看？

source: Stuffed Stocking
translation: 塞得满满的长袜

source: Th-That stocking is stuffed…
translation: 那、那只长袜塞得满满的……

source: It’s about to be stuffed somewhere else~
translation: 它马上就要被塞到别的地方去了哦～

source: What? You’re dressed like you’re ready to crack some nuts, anyways.
translation: 什么？反正你穿得就像准备去敲碎几颗坚果一样。

source: *sigh* Have you been spending too much time around Aiden?
translation: *叹气* 你是不是和Aiden待得太久了？

source: Hah! Hardly.
translation: 哈！怎么会。

source: Besides, let’s be honest, with how the last few days have been, we could both use some heat.
translation: 再说，说实话，经历了这几天的事，我们两个都需要一点热度。

source: So, come over here and warm up with me before the party…
translation: 所以，在派对开始前过来和我一起暖和一下吧……

source: The sides of my jacket don’t even connect. Closing it is impossible.
translation: 我夹克的两侧根本连不到一起。想扣上是不可能的。

source: Good thing you warmed me up beforehand.
translation: 幸好你事先把我暖和起来了。

source: I have to say though, your costume suits you very well. You’re quite the expert at nut cracking, as I saw.
translation: 不过我得说，你这身服装很适合你。正如我所见，你可真擅长敲坚果。

source: *sigh* You already made that joke...
translation: *叹气* 你已经开过这个玩笑了……

source: But I’m not joking.
translation: 但我不是在开玩笑。

source: There you two are!! What took you so long?! You missed the champagne popping!
translation: 你们两个在这儿啊！！怎么这么久？！你们错过开香槟了！

source: I was popping something else.
translation: 我刚才在“开”别的东西。

source: A-Ah! W-We had trouble putting on our costumes!
translation: 啊、啊！我、我们穿服装时遇到了点麻烦！

source: Yoshi, this is no different than when you put on your camp uniform! And Dad, yours is literally a two-piece outfit!
translation: Yoshi，这和你穿营地制服时没什么不同！还有，爸爸，你那身真的就两件！

source: You both should’ve moved at double time since we were waiting for you!
translation: 既然我们在等你们，你们两个就该加快速度！

source: Give us a break, Yuri. We spent the whole day outside digging.
translation: 饶了我们吧，Yuri。我们整天都在外面挖雪。

source: Poor Yoshinori here was panting like a dog a few minutes ago.
translation: 可怜的Yoshinori几分钟前还在这里像条狗一样喘气。

source: So, what do you want to do for the night, Yoshinori?
translation: 那么，Yoshinori，今晚你想做什么？

source: So, what do you want to do for the night, Yoshinori?{fast}
translation: 那么，Yoshinori，今晚你想做什么？{fast}

source: Join the games.
translation: 加入游戏。

source: Chill out.
translation: 放松一下。

source: Why don’t we get something to eat?
translation: 我们去吃点东西怎么样？

source: Oh? You still have an appetite after your ‘meal’ earlier?
translation: 哦？你在刚才那顿“饭”之后还有胃口吗？

source: G-Gah! You’d think after a couple months, I’d be used to you teasing me like this, sir…
translation: 呃、呃啊！过了几个月，我本以为自己已经习惯您这样取笑我了，先生……

source: Hahaha! I understand why Aiden does it so often. You make it too easy.
translation: 哈哈哈！我明白Aiden为什么经常这么做了。你实在太容易被逗了。

source: A-Anyway, let’s check out the food bar.
translation: 总、总之，我们去看看食物吧。

source: Hmm, it looks your favorite meatballs ran out, sir.
translation: 嗯，看起来您最喜欢的肉丸吃完了，先生。

source: Maybe there’s still some left in the kitchen.
translation: 厨房里也许还剩一些。

source: Oh yeah. I don’t see Aiden around. Maybe he’s making another serving!
translation: 哦，对。我没看到Aiden。也许他正在做下一份！

source: Why don’t we go and see then?
translation: 那我们过去看看吧？

source: You got the sauce simmering, little chef?
translation: 小厨师，酱汁在炖着了吗？

source: Yup! It should be good, I’m just starting on the meatballs now!
translation: 嗯！应该没问题，我现在正开始做肉丸！

source: Alright! Keep it up, bro!
translation: 好！继续加油，兄弟！

source: Hey there, Aiden! …And Hiro?
translation: 嘿，Aiden！……还有Hiro？

source: Oh, heya Scoutmaster Yoshi and Sir Goro!
translation: 哦，童子军团长Yoshi和Goro先生！

source: Looks like you’ve put Hiro to work here, Aiden. Shouldn’t he be out partying with his friends?
translation: 看来你让Hiro在这里干活了，Aiden。他不该和朋友们出去参加派对吗？

source: It’s not like that, sir! I was actually dying to get in the kitchen and help Bro Aiden out!
translation: 不是那样的，先生！其实我特别想进厨房帮Aiden大哥的忙！

source: Haha, yup! The little guy was begging to come help, and I just couldn’t say no to that face.
translation: 哈哈，没错！这个小家伙求着要来帮忙，我实在没法拒绝那张脸。

source: Woops, looks like the rolls are done.
translation: 哎呀，看来小面包烤好了。

source: On it, bro!
translation: 我来，兄弟！

source: Wow, you two are really in sync with each other. It’s almost like you’ve been cooking together forever.
translation: 哇，你们两个真是默契。简直像是一直都在一起做饭。

source: Haha, well I did spend most of the summer helping Bro Aiden out in here.
translation: 哈哈，嗯，我确实花了大半个夏天在这里帮Aiden大哥。

source: He taught me a lot about what it’s like to cook for a crowd, and how to be quicker in the kitchen~
translation: 他教了我很多为一大群人做饭的诀窍，还有如何在厨房里动作更快～

source: Not only that, but he’s leveled up his cooking skills too, you guys should try some of his snacks!
translation: 不仅如此，他的厨艺也进步了，你们应该尝尝他做的点心！

source: Oh, sure! I’d love to.
translation: 哦，当然！我很乐意。

source: Here you guys go! Tell me what you think~
translation: 给你们！告诉我你们觉得怎么样～

source: Th-This is amazing, Hiro!
translation: 这、这太棒了，Hiro！

source: Yes, it’s as good as Aiden’s.
translation: 是的，和Aiden做得一样好。

source: Awww, look how much my little chef has grown!
translation: 啊，看我的小厨师成长了这么多！

source: Alright! I’m gonna bring it out to the group then, bro!
translation: 好！那我把它端给大家，兄弟！

source: I really want ‘him’ to taste this—
translation: 我真想让“他”尝尝这个——

source: BUTTCHEEKS! TORCH-HEAD!
translation: BUTTCHEEKS！TORCH-HEAD！

source: Where the hell’s the food?! I’m starving!
translation: 食物到底在哪儿？！我快饿死了！

source: Ugh, shouldn’t you have assigned feeding times already, Wolfboy?
translation: 唉，你不是早该安排好喂食时间了吗，Wolfboy？

source: Shut it! And why are these old geezers in here? Are they getting to eat the new batch before the rest of us?!
translation: 闭嘴！还有，这些老家伙为什么在这里？他们能比我们其他人更早吃到新一批吗？！

source: HEY!
translation: 喂！

source: *munch, munch*
translation: *嚼嚼，嚼嚼*

source: Eh, not bad.
translation: 呃，还不错。

source: WHAT?! You just wolfed down half the plate and all you can say is ‘not bad?!’
translation: 什么？！你刚狼吞虎咽吃掉半盘，结果就只会说“还不错”？！

source: Yeah, I’ve had better. But I guess this’ll do.
translation: 是啊，我吃过更好的。不过这也凑合。

source: Hey! What the hell, I worked hard on that!
translation: 喂！搞什么鬼，我可是很用心做的！

source: Bring it back!
translation: 还回来！

source: Ahehe, I guess Hiro and Yoichi still argue as much as they did before…
translation: 啊哈哈，看来Hiro和Yoichi还是和以前一样爱吵嘴……

source: Hahaha, but that just shows how good of friends they are!
translation: 哈哈哈，但这正说明他们是多好的朋友！

source: Still, I’m impressed by his cooking. I don’t think we’ve had another scout since you that was that capable, Aiden.
translation: 不过，他的厨艺确实让我佩服。我想自从你之后，我们还没有过这么能干的童子军，Aiden。

source: Heh, maybe he’d like a job as your sous chef one day.
translation: 呵，也许有一天他会想当你的副厨师。

source: I’d like that! He and I get along great in the kitchen! With a little more experience, he’ll be as good as me… or even better!
translation: 我会很乐意！他和我在厨房里配合得很好！再多一点经验，他会和我一样出色……甚至更厉害！

source: J-Just don’t teach him all your habits, alright?
translation: 只、只要别把你的那些习惯全教给他，好吗？

source: Why not~? He’ll get real friendly with the other campers then, hehe~
translation: 为什么不呢～？那样他就会和其他营员变得非常亲热，嘿嘿～

source: *ehem* Anyway, we just came to get some of those meatballs.
translation: *咳哼* 总之，我们只是来拿些肉丸。

source: Oho~ You’re feeling forward tonight, are you Gramps~?
translation: 哦吼～Gramps，你今晚很主动嘛～？

source: There’s enough ‘meat’ and ‘balls’ for you both!
translation: “肉”和“球”足够你们两个享用了！

source: {i}After getting some snacks from Aiden, we munched on them and chatted with him and Hiro for a while longer.{/i}
translation: {i}从Aiden那里拿到一些零食后，我们一边吃着，一边又和他及Hiro聊了一会儿。{/i}

source: {i}Hiro told us about all the stuff he’d been trying in the kitchen since leaving camp, and before long he and Aiden were totally wrapped up in conversation about it!{/i}
translation: {i}Hiro告诉我们，自从离开营地后，他在厨房里尝试了许多东西；没过多久，他和Aiden就完全沉浸在相关的话题里！{/i}

source: {i}I’m glad he and Aiden have such a strong bond!{/i}
translation: {i}我很高兴他和Aiden之间有这么深厚的羁绊！{/i}

source: It looks like Yuri’s hosting a game with some of the scouts.
translation: 看来Yuri正在和一些童子军主持游戏。

source: Want to check it out?
translation: 想去看看吗？

source: Yeah! Maybe we can join in too!
translation: 好啊！也许我们也能加入！

source: Hehe, Yoshinori… We're not that young anymore…
translation: 嘿嘿，Yoshinori……我们已经没那么年轻了……

source: Like this…?
translation: 像这样……？

source: Bend your hips a little, Natsumi! You’re too stiff!
translation: 腰稍微弯一点，Natsumi！你太僵硬了！

source: Uhh… I’m not sure modeling is something I’m good at, Ms. Yuri.
translation: 呃……Yuri女士，我不确定当模特是不是我擅长的事。

source: Hngh… Stay still, Natsumi…
translation: 唔……别动，Natsumi……

source: Hey there! Looks like something’s interesting’s going on here.
translation: 嘿！看来这里正发生着有趣的事。

source: Oh hey, Dad, Yoshi! Good of you two to finally join the party with everyone!
translation: 哦，嘿，爸爸、Yoshi！你们两个终于来和大家一起参加派对了，真好！

source: What game are you all playing…? Natsumi’s doing some really... provocative poses.
translation: 你们在玩什么游戏……？Natsumi正在摆一些非常……挑逗的姿势。

source: O-Oh… We’re not playing a game, sir. I’m sketching up a fanfic for Ms. Yuri, and Natsumi’s modeling for the cover.
translation: 哦、哦……我们不是在玩游戏，先生。我正在为Yuri女士的同人小说画草图，Natsumi在为封面当模特。

source: Ahhh, yes~ I’m still working on the title. I’m stuck choosing between ‘Schlonging for You’~ or ‘Booty and the Feast!’
translation: 啊啊，是的～我还在想标题。现在正纠结该选《为你掏出大家伙》～还是《美臀与盛宴！》

source: Both of them sound… wrong.
translation: 两个听起来都……不对劲。

source: Oh, it’s actually interesting though, sir! It’s a romantic story of two partners separated by fate! They’re desperate for each other, but torn apart by destiny!
translation: 哦，但它其实很有意思，先生！这是一个被命运分开的两位恋人的浪漫故事！他们拼命渴望彼此，却又被命运拆散！

source: *sigh* Yuri… Why are you making the scouts work during a party?
translation: *叹气* Yuri……你为什么要在派对期间让童子军工作？

source: Oh, this isn’t ‘just’ work! I’m giving Hunter here some training for his blooming art career!
translation: 哦，这可不“只是”工作！我正在给Hunter做些训练，帮助他蓬勃发展的艺术事业！

source: Y-Yes… Creative writing is also part of my college curriculum, and I figured I could learn a lot from Ms. Yuri on how to coordinate it with my art.
translation: 是、是的……创意写作也是我大学课程的一部分，我觉得能从Yuri女士那里学到很多，知道如何让它与我的艺术结合。

source: *sigh* You two are coming with me. We’re going to party.
translation: *叹气* 你们两个跟我来。我们去参加派对。

source: S-Sir Goro, wait…!
translation: 吾、Goro先生，等等……！

source: Awwwww… There goes my artist AND subject.
translation: 啊啊啊……我的画家和模特都走了。

source: Haha, it’s really nice to see you get excited when it comes to anything art related.
translation: 哈哈，看到你一遇到和艺术有关的事就这么兴奋，真好。

source: Yeah, I’m not really good at it myself, but a part of me kinda wishes I was.
translation: 是啊，我自己其实不太擅长，但内心有一部分还是希望自己擅长。

source: Even though it’d take a lot of time and effort, I think you could do it!
translation: 虽然会花很多时间和精力，但我觉得你做得到！

source: Well… The funny thing is I used to try when I was younger, but as soon as Dad and I found out that we both enjoyed camping, I shifted my focus.
translation: 嗯……有趣的是，我年轻时确实尝试过，但我和爸爸一发现我们都喜欢露营，我就转移了重心。

source: Not that I blame Dad, he always supported me no matter what my interests were.
translation: 我不是在怪爸爸，不管我的兴趣是什么，他总是支持我。

source: Well, what’s stopping you from going back to it now?
translation: 那么，现在有什么阻止你重新拾起它呢？

source: Well… when everyone left after the first term, my only goal was helping Dad run the camps. And I had to relocate to handle one of the other branches.
translation: 嗯……第一个营期结束后，大家都离开了，我唯一的目标就是帮爸爸经营营地。而且我还得搬去管理另一个分部。

source: Things were so crazy busy for the both of us that we didn’t have time for ourselves, you know?
translation: 我们两个都忙得不可开交，根本没有留给自己的时间，你知道吗？

source: Yeah, I can understand that…
translation: 是啊，我能理解……

source: But now… I think I might just have the chance again, after everything settles down with this project.
translation: 但现在……等这个项目的一切安定下来后，我想我可能又有机会了。

source: Well, I think this off-season is the perfect time to start!
translation: 嗯，我觉得这个淡季正是开始的最佳时机！

source: You have some time to train, and you’d be able to come up with some really fun activities for the scouts!
translation: 你有时间练习，而且还能为童子军想出一些非常有趣的活动！

source: We may be in the middle of our work, but Sir Goro and I have the management stuff covered!
translation: 我们或许正忙着工作，但Goro先生和我会把管理方面的事都处理好！

source: Yeaaah I really owe you big time for taking over my job as Dad’s secretary.
translation: 是啊，你接手了我给爸爸当秘书的工作，我真的太欠你人情了。

source: Even though I’ve been at it for years, you honestly already handle it much better than me.
translation: 尽管我做了很多年，但说真的，你已经处理得比我好得多。

source: Since he’s my dad, I can get complacent working with him and complain a lot, which he tolerates for some reason.
translation: 因为他是我爸爸，和他一起工作时我会变得懈怠、还总抱怨，而他不知为何一直容忍着。

source: With you, he’s much more productive! And considering how much he’s mellowed out recently, I don’t think I have to worry about him as much anymore!
translation: 有你在，他的效率高多了！再考虑到他最近温和了许多，我觉得自己不用再那么担心他了！

source: Haha, you can count on me, Yuri~ Take the chance you have and do the things you always wanted to.
translation: 哈哈，你可以放心交给我，Yuri～抓住这个机会，去做你一直想做的事。

source: Alright! I’m pumped up! Thanks, Yoshi!
translation: 好！我干劲十足了！谢谢，Yoshi！

source: I’m going to get my sketchbook and get started right now!
translation: 我要去拿素描本，现在就开始！

source: W-Wait, Yuri…! What about the—
translation: 等、等等，Yuri……那——

source: …party.
translation: ……派对呢。

source: {i}Yuri and Goro have always shared such a close bond, and I can tell how much they’ve both sacrificed for each other.{/i}
translation: {i}Yuri和Goro一直有着如此亲密的羁绊，我能看出他们都为彼此牺牲了很多。{/i}

source: {i}I’m glad Yuri’s finally getting to explore herself a bit more!{/i}
translation: {i}我很高兴Yuri终于能够更多地探索自己！{/i}

source: {i}After Yuri ran off, I went over to Goro and chatted with him and the scouts for the rest of the night.{/i}
translation: {i}Yuri跑开后，我来到Goro身边，在接下来的夜晚里和他及童子军们聊天。{/i}

source: Hehe, now we’re talking!
translation: 嘿嘿，这才对嘛！

source: I see Lloyd and Darius with Mr. Clermont doing just that over there! Let’s join them!
translation: 我看到Lloyd和Darius正和Clermont先生在那边做这个！我们去加入他们吧！

source: Ah, Yoshinori, Goro, please take a seat!
translation: 啊，Yoshinori、Goro，请坐！

source: We were just chatting with Mr. Clermont about our time as Camp Buddy scouts!
translation: 我们刚刚在和Clermont先生聊我们在伙伴营地当童子军的时光！

source: That and having booze.
translation: 还有喝酒。

source: Come now, Goro. We’re outside the workspace, we can be more personal and call each other by our names!
translation: 来吧，Goro。我们不在工作场所，可以更随意些，直接叫彼此的名字！

source: Anyway, I was just chatting with Lloyd and Darius here about how fortunate we were to find them!
translation: 总之，我刚才正和Lloyd、Darius聊我们能找到他们是多么幸运！

source: Would you believe it was less than a day after we posted the application that they responded?
translation: 你相信吗？我们发布招聘信息后还不到一天，他们就回复了？

source: Whoa! Really?!
translation: 哇！真的？！

source: Yes! From my understanding, Lloyd was quite eager to return here in particular.
translation: 是的！据我所知，尤其是Lloyd非常渴望回到这里。

source: Yeah! It was actually destined from way before!
translation: 没错！其实很早以前就注定了！

source: Hmm? How so?
translation: 嗯？怎么说？

source: Well, Dar and I had just finished a really crappy job right before the posting.
translation: 嗯，在那份招聘信息发布前，Dar和我刚做完一份特别烂的工作。

source: I was telling him that I wanted to do something more meaningful, and figured I should consult my tarots!
translation: 我正告诉他，我想做些更有意义的事，于是觉得该去问问我的塔罗牌！

source: Oh, you’re an occult fan, Lloyd?
translation: 哦，你是神秘学爱好者，Lloyd？

source: Yes, sir! I absolutely LOVE it!
translation: 是的，先生！我超级喜欢！

source: He’s a fanatic.
translation: 他是个狂热分子。

source: Haha! That’s quite fascinating.
translation: 哈哈！这真有意思。

source: Anyway, when I was trying to get my cards out, I stumbled on my old badge collection from Camp Buddy.
translation: 总之，当我想把卡牌拿出来时，偶然发现了我以前的伙伴营地徽章收藏。

source: I hadn’t seen it in years and I had a crazy thought…
translation: 我已经好多年没见过它了，于是冒出一个疯狂的想法……

source: Maybe I could use it for a divination!
translation: 也许我可以用它来占卜！

source: I literally never thought the badges would be used like that…
translation: 我做梦也没想到徽章还能这么用……

source: *ehem* So I started stacking up the patches like a deck of cards, and drew three to foretell my fate.
translation: *咳哼* 所以我开始把徽章像一副卡牌那样叠起来，并抽出三枚来预言我的命运。

source: Lo and behold, it showed me the ‘Camping’ badge, the ‘Buddy’ badge, and my ‘Crafting badge’!
translation: 瞧瞧看，它显示给我的是“露营”徽章、“伙伴”徽章，还有我的“手工制作”徽章！

source: Which are the only three badges you earned.
translation: 而那正是你仅有的三枚徽章。

source: I knew it must’ve a sign! My future showed that I would be ‘Crafting in Camp Buddy’!
translation: 我就知道那一定是个征兆！我的未来显示我会在“伙伴营地做手工”！

source: H-How else could you have read that…?
translation: 不、不然你还能怎么解读……？

source: Let me finish!
translation: 让我说完！

source: After that, I searched for Camp Buddy on the internet, and the first thing that popped up was Mr. Clermont’s job opening!
translation: 之后，我在网上搜索了伙伴营地，第一个跳出来的就是Clermont先生的招聘岗位！

source: He came running and screaming to see me as soon as he saw it.
translation: 他一看到就尖叫着跑来找我。

source: I couldn’t help it! It was more perfectly-timed than any reading I’ve ever had!
translation: 我忍不住嘛！这比我经历过的任何一次占卜都更恰到好处！

source: I don’t think it was even a reading…
translation: 我甚至不觉得那算是一次占卜……

source: It definitely was! How else could you explain all those things happening?!
translation: 当然是！不然你怎么解释这些事情接连发生？！

source: Hahaha! Well, maybe it really was fate then that landed you here!
translation: 哈哈哈！那么，也许真的是命运把你们带到了这里！

source: Yes, sir! I really believe it was!
translation: 是的，先生！我真的相信是这样！

source: Well, let’s have a toast then! To the whims of fate!
translation: 那么，我们来干一杯吧！敬命运的安排！

source: Aha! So, you’re the one who took my booze, Snow-BALLS!
translation: 啊哈！原来是你拿走了我的酒，雪球！

source: {i}Lloyd claimed it was all due to ‘fortune’, but it was clear he was the captain of his own destiny.{/i}
translation: {i}Lloyd声称一切都是“命运”使然，但很明显，他才是自己命运的掌舵人。{/i}

source: {i}Goro and I ended up spending the evening drinking with Mr. Clermont, Lloyd and Darius, while the rest of the scouts ate and played games.{/i}
translation: {i}当其他童子军吃东西、玩游戏时，Goro和我则和Clermont先生、Lloyd及Darius一起喝酒度过夜晚。{/i}

source: Let’s just chill out for a while.
translation: 我们就放松一会儿吧。

source: Hehe, I figured you’d want to relax, especially after working up a sweat.
translation: 嘿嘿，我就知道你会想放松一下，尤其是出了这么多汗之后。

source: It’s not easy being a receiver, you know… Especially with someone your size.
translation: 你知道，做被动的一方可不容易……尤其对方还是你这个体型。

source: Nonsense. You’re already used to it.
translation: 胡说。你已经习惯了。

source: We should try switching it up sometimes, though… I want to be able to do it to you too.
translation: 不过我们偶尔也该换一换……我也想能对你这么做。

source: No thanks. I prefer giving rather than taking. I’m generous like that.
translation: 不了，谢谢。我更喜欢主动，而不是被动。我就是这么慷慨。

source: *sigh* Come on, Goro. Just once, let me try it too.
translation: *叹气* 拜托了，Goro。就一次，让我也试试。

source: Well, if you’re going to beg like that.
translation: 嗯，既然你要这样求我。

source: Beg for daddy…
translation: 求爸爸……

source: Uh… Why is Jin peeking over there?
translation: 呃……Jin为什么在那边偷看？

source: Hello, Jin. What are you doing?
translation: 你好，Jin。你在做什么？

source: Come over here. I want to see your costume.
translation: 到这里来。我想看看你的服装。

source: Ah, would you look at that. This angel outfit really shows off your innocence.
translation: 啊，看看这个。这套天使装真能衬出你的纯真。

source: Sir Goro’s costume just looks so hot— I mean, cool!
translation: Goro先生的服装看起来实在太火辣——我是说，太酷了！

source: Hah! If you think that’s cool then you should’ve seen what I wore last summer!
translation: 哈！如果你觉得这很酷，那你该看看我去年夏天穿了什么！

source: Hello, Sir Goro and Scoutmaster Yoshi!
translation: 您好，Goro先生、童子军团长Yoshi！

source: Good evening, you two. Not hanging out with your friends?
translation: 晚上好，你们两个。不和朋友们待在一起吗？

source: Nahhh. Hanging out with those dorks over the weekend was already enough for me.
translation: 不了。周末和那群书呆子混在一起已经够我受的了。

source: Ssssh, Taiga! Hiro and Yoichi might hear you…!
translation: 嘘，Taiga！Hiro和Yoichi可能会听到……！

source: W-Wait, wait… Did you have a costume party during the summer too?!
translation: 等、等等……夏天时你们也办过化装派对？！

source: Yeah! It was just like this where Ms. Yuri had costumes ready for everyone!
translation: 是啊！和这次一样，Yuri女士给每个人都准备好了服装！

source: Heh, I’m pretty proud to say I made mine, though~
translation: 呵，不过我很自豪地说，我那身是自己做的～

source: Haha, you should know Taiga’s quite the crafty scout!
translation: 哈哈，你该知道Taiga是个相当心灵手巧的童子军！

source: Didn’t you add some custom body paint as well?
translation: 你不是还加了一些定制的人体彩绘吗？

source: My idea was sort of a savage warrior, and it was super dope!
translation: 我的想法有点像野蛮战士，超级酷！

source: Wow… That sounds… wild…
translation: 哇……听起来……很狂野……

source: Now I’m really curious how that party went.
translation: 现在我真的很好奇那场派对是怎样的。

source: Hehe, I’d say it was pretty fun! I have lots of memories about it!
translation: 嘿嘿，我得说那相当有趣！我对此有很多回忆！

source: Oh, you have your own blog?
translation: 哦，你有自己的博客？

source: Not exactly. It’s actually for Camp Buddy.
translation: 不完全是。其实是给伙伴营地的。

source: We’re actually chronicling the memories going all the way back to my term as a scout to post on there!
translation: 我们其实在记录一路追溯到我当童子军时期的回忆，准备发布在上面！

source: Ohhh, is it like a digital journal?
translation: 哦哦，是像电子日记那样吗？

source: Yes! Do you want to help? I’d love to hear more about the party!
translation: 是的！你想帮忙吗？我很想多听听那场派对的事！

source: Yeah! Taiga and I like to write too!
translation: 是啊！Taiga和我也喜欢写作！

source: Where do we even start though…?
translation: 不过我们该从哪儿开始呢……？

source: Let’s start with Sir Goro’s costume, he wore the lamest one out of everyone! Hahaha!
translation: 就从Goro先生的服装开始吧，他穿的是所有人里最逊的一套！哈哈哈！

source: *ehem* You should know that panda onesie was a back-up costume.
translation: *咳哼* 你们该知道，那套熊猫连体衣只是备用服装。

source: Oh, yeah…! You had a much more risqué one you were supposed to wear…
translation: 哦，对……！你本来还该穿一套大胆得多的服装……

source: R-Risque? I’m listening…
translation: 大、大胆？我在听……

source: Well, I did end up showing it during the after party. I’m sure you remember, Yoshinori.
translation: 嗯，我最后确实在派对后续活动时展示过它。我相信你记得，Yoshinori。

source: Hnghh! An after party?!
translation: 唔！派对后续活动？！

source: L-Let me get my laptop and we’ll get started!
translation: 让、让我去拿笔记本电脑，我们就开始吧！

source: Fwahhh! You really brought out the good stuff tonight, Gramps!
translation: 哇啊啊！Gramps，你今晚真的拿出了好东西！

source: Heh, it’s a celebration after all. No reason not to drink my finest booze.
translation: 呵，毕竟是庆祝。没有理由不喝我最好的酒。

source: Hahaha! I could get drunk on this stuff every night! Damn, it’s tasty!
translation: 哈哈哈！我每天晚上都能喝这玩意儿喝醉！天啊，真好喝！

source: A-Aiden, shh! If Yuri finds us out here, she’ll kill us!
translation: 艾、Aiden，嘘！要是Yuri发现我们在这里，她会杀了我们的！

source: Aww, come on, Yoshi, relax! She’s already in bed!
translation: 啊，拜托，Yoshi，放松！她已经上床了！

source: We deserve this break, anyway. We just worked super hard on the fundraiser all week long!
translation: 反正我们也该休息一下。我们整个星期都在为筹款活动拼命工作！

source: You two quit chit-chatting and get back to the game. Don’t think I’ll let you quit while I’m winning!
translation: 你们两个别闲聊了，回到游戏上来。别以为我领先时会让你们退出！

source: It’ll take you way longer than that, Aiden! Your costume has too many layers!
translation: 那得花你更久时间，Aiden！你的服装层数太多了！

source: Come on, show your hands already! I’m at seven.
translation: 快点，亮牌吧！我是七点。

source: Hah! I’ve got nine.
translation: 哈！我是九点。

source: Twelve for me, so looks like I win!
translation: 我十二点，看来是我赢了！

source: Damn!
translation: 可恶！

source: Hahaha! So much for your winning streak, Gramps!
translation: 哈哈哈！你的连胜到此为止了，Gramps！

source: And speaking of streak, come on! Off with the onesie!
translation: 说到连胜，来吧！脱掉连体衣！

source: A-Aiden, is it really fair to make him do that since he’s only wearing one thing…?
translation: 艾、Aiden，他只穿了一件衣服，还让他这么做真的公平吗……？

source: *ehem* No, but—
translation: *咳哼* 没有，但是——

source: No buts! Get rid of the onesie!
translation: 没有但是！脱掉连体衣！

source: Fine.
translation: 好吧。

source: WHOA! What the hell is that, Gramps?!
translation: 哇！那是什么鬼，Gramps？！

source: *sigh* This is the costume I had originally picked out… I intended it to be a match with Yoshinori.
translation: *叹气* 这是我原本挑选的服装……我本想让它和Yoshinori的服装相配。

source: I thought about wearing it to the party, but Yuri didn’t want anyone to see me like this.
translation: 我想过穿它参加派对，但Yuri不想让任何人看到我这个样子。

source: So instead, you were sneaking around in it under a blanket. Kinky~
translation: 所以，你反而裹着毯子、穿着它偷偷摸摸溜达。真有情趣～

source: Th-That’s not what it was for, you brat!
translation: 那、那不是拿来干那个的，你这臭小子！

source: Pfft, something on your mind, Yoshi~?
translation: 噗，你在想什么呢，Yoshi～？

source: H-Huh? What?
translation: 啊、啊？什么？

source: I know Gramps’ costume is some serious eye candy, but we got another round to play! Quit staring and let’s go!
translation: 我知道Gramps的服装非常养眼，但我们还要再玩一轮！别盯着看了，开始吧！

source: A-Aiden! I wasn’t… but fine! Let’s go!
translation: 艾、Aiden！我没有……但好吧！开始吧！

source: Alright! Final round, so loser drinks what’s left in the bottle AND has to do what the winner says!
translation: 好！最后一轮，所以输家要喝掉瓶里剩下的酒，还得做赢家说的事！

source: *sigh* Aiden, you’re really drunk now, aren’t you?
translation: *叹气* Aiden，你现在真的喝醉了，是吧？

source: Yup! But I’m doing you a favor and letting you pick which of our hot bods you want on your plate tonight~
translation: 没错！但我是在帮你，让你挑今晚想把我们哪个火辣的身体端上盘子～

source: *hic* Now read ’em and weep! I got a… a…
translation: *打嗝* 现在看牌哭吧！我拿到了一张……一张……

source: Gah! Is he alright?!
translation: 啊！他没事吧？！

source: Heh, looks like he passed out. That boy can never handle his liquor.
translation: 呵，看来他昏过去了。那孩子从来就喝不了酒。

source: *sigh* I guess we should get him to bed then.
translation: *叹气* 我想我们该把他送去睡觉了。

source: Not so fast, Yoshinori. I believe we have a game to finish.
translation: 别急，Yoshinori。我相信我们还有一场游戏没结束。

source: Eh? B-But sir, that was just Aiden—
translation: 咦？但、但是先生，那只是Aiden——

source: Come on, Yoshinori. Chickening out now?
translation: 来吧，Yoshinori。现在要临阵退缩吗？

source: N-No, sir! I-I guess we can keep playing…
translation: 不、不是，先生！我、我想我们可以继续玩……

source: Alright! I’ve got ten. And you?
translation: 好！我是十点。你呢？

source: Two…
translation: 两点……

source: Hah! Looks like I pulled through for the win.
translation: 哈！看来我坚持到了胜利。

source: Guess you’re doing whatever I say now, Yoshinori.
translation: 看来现在你要照我说的做了，Yoshinori。

source: Wh-What?! But that was just Aiden’s drunk idea! We never—
translation: 什、什么？！但那只是Aiden醉酒后的主意！我们从来没有——

source: Don’t worry, Yoshinori. I’ll cover half of your bet.
translation: 别担心，Yoshinori。我会替你承担一半赌注。

source: *swigs the alcohol*
translation: *大口喝酒*

source: Hahhhh! So, now that I’ve taken care of that, it looks like you owe me.
translation: 哈啊啊！那么，现在我已经处理好那部分，看来你欠我的了。

source: Come on, cowboy. Let’s see how you handle a hot-blooded bull.
translation: 来吧，牛仔。让我们看看你怎么应付一头热血的公牛。

source: A s-secret strip show…
translation: 一、一场秘密脱衣秀……

source: I-I didn’t think you guys were up to something like that…
translation: 我、我没想到你们会做这种事……

source: Somehow, I think you’re both cooler now.
translation: 不知怎么的，我觉得你们两个现在更酷了。

source: Taiga!
translation: Taiga！

source: *ehem* Well, once we’ve had a few drinks, things tend to get a little ‘looser.’
translation: *咳哼* 嗯，喝了几杯之后，事情往往会变得更“放得开”。

source: Heh, right Yoshinori?
translation: 呵，对吧，Yoshinori？

source: Gah!
translation: 啊！

source: *sigh* These two aren’t very subtle with their innuendos.
translation: *叹气* 这两个人说荤段子一点也不含蓄。

source: Eh? What was it?
translation: 咦？是什么？

source: Seriously, Keitaro?
translation: 认真的，Keitaro？

source: A-Anyway, I think Jin has enough information! Thanks for helping, you two!
translation: 总、总之，我想Jin已经得到足够的信息了！谢谢你们两个的帮忙！

source: No problem, Scoutmaster Yoshi!
translation: 不客气，童子军团长Yoshi！

source: Come on, let’s all get back to the party.
translation: 来吧，我们都回派对去。

source: And get Jin some tissues for whatever other ‘fluids’ he needs to get rid of.
translation: 再给Jin拿些纸巾，让他处理掉其他需要清理的“体液”。

source: {i}After working on the blog, we all headed to get some snacks and told Jin more stories about the previous term.{/i}
translation: {i}整理完博客后，我们都去拿了些零食，又给Jin讲了更多上个营期的故事。{/i}
